deadline.value: All applications are due November 20 at 10 p.m. Mountain Time (year inferred for Fall 2027).
deadline.quote: The deadline for all applications is 10 p.m. Mountain Time, November 20.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are recommended for the Behavioral Neuroscience program (other subplans differ).
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are recommended for admission into the Behavioral Neuroscience Graduate Program.

toefl_min.value: The department asks for TOEFL iBT 91 from applicants whose education was not in English.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language: 91

ielts_min.value: The department page asks for IELTS 7.5 (the Graduate School table shows 7.0).

supervisor.value: Direct-admit model: students are admitted into a faculty lab with no rotations, and applicants are encouraged to contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: The Behavioral Neuroscience Graduate Program utilizes a direct-admit model where prospective students are admitted into the faculty laboratory of their choice (i.e., no rotations). We encourage prospective students to contact faculty members prior to applying

funding.value: Accepted students receive financial support through TA and RA positions plus a tuition waiver while employed.
funding.quote: Students who are accepted into the Behavioral Neuroscience graduate program are provided with financial support for their graduate education.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree from an accredited institution is required; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: You must have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked
